uslaw-usc-t1-s5:
Section 5 of Title 1 of the United States Code is a rule for reading federal statutes, on the words company and association. It sits in Chapter 1 of Title 1, on rules of construction, in the text current through Public Law 119-134.

The whole provision is one sentence. When the word company or the word association is used in reference to a corporation, it is deemed to take in the words successors and assigns of such company or association. The section adds that this holds in like manner as if those words, or words of similar import, were written out in the text.
uslaw-usc-t2-s5: Section 5 of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with the naming of men for a poll at large. It sits in Chapter 1, on the polls for Senators and Representatives. Men who stand for Representative to be chosen at large in a state are the subject. Such men are to be named in the same way as men who stand for governor of the state. A bar is set where the laws of the state give a second way.
